name: Vantablack Media Parasocial Carrier Mask
description: The Parasocial Carrier Mask is a thin, flexible adhesive overlay — resembling a cosmetic skin patch or AR display membrane — worn on the face, neck, or forearm. It functions by encoding encrypted communication data into the metadata streams of legitimate Vantablack Media social broadcast signals: facial expression data, biometric affectation packets, and audience-engagement telemetry that are continuously transmitted by millions of GLMZ residents who use Vantablack's ubiquitous personal broadcast ecosystem. The Mask injects covert data into these streams at the packet level, routing messages through Vantablack's own commercial broadcast infrastructure as invisible passengers inside ordinary social media traffic.

specifications.dimensions: Variable — standard facial overlay 22cm x 14cm; forearm variant 18cm x 8cm
specifications.range: Global, wherever Vantablack Media broadcast infrastructure exists
specifications.bandwidth: Up to 800 bps covert channel within standard broadcast stream
specifications.encryption: Layered — outer layer mimics legitimate telemetry; inner payload uses 256-bit asymmetric cipher
specifications.power_source: Harvested from wearer's skin bioelectricity; no battery required
specifications.wear_duration: Up to 96 hours before adhesive degradation
specifications.detectability: Indistinguishable from legitimate Vantablack broadcast traffic without proprietary analysis keys

tactical_use: The Mask is the preferred tool for long-range covert communication in environments where any RF transmission would be flagged or traced. The operator simply wears the device while passively existing in any area with Vantablack Media coverage — which is most of the inhabited city — and their messages ride out invisibly inside the ambient social data fog. Because the channel is embedded in commercial traffic generated by millions of simultaneous users, isolating any individual covert signal requires either the Vantablack Media proprietary detection suite or extraordinary analytical resources. The device is particularly valued for communication across corpo border checkpoints and through heavily monitored transit corridors.
cultural_context: Vantablack Media has aggressively and publicly denied any knowledge of the Carrier Mask's existence, while simultaneously — according to leaks from inside their infrastructure division — maintaining a dedicated team tasked with finding and closing the exploit the device relies on. The cat-and-mouse dynamic has become something of an open secret in GLMZ's hacker and fixer communities. There is profound irony in the fact that Vantablack Media, whose commercial empire is built on monetizing the intimate details of its users' faces and bodies, has inadvertently created the most robust covert communication channel in the city. Some users wear the Mask as a political statement as much as a practical tool.
known_users: High-tier operatives requiring intercontinental covert channels
Corporate whistleblowers exfiltrating data under surveillance
Individuals under active signal monitoring who cannot go dark
story_hooks: Vantablack Media's latest platform update appears to have partially patched the exploit — Masks manufactured before a certain date still work, but new ones don't. The value of existing units has tripled overnight.
A player receives a covert message through a Mask they aren't wearing — someone has spoofed their biometric signature and is using their identity as a carrier channel.

Vantablack Media approaches the players with an unusual offer: help them identify who manufactures and distributes the Mask, in exchange for something very valuable. The obvious question is why they don't just fix the exploit instead.
A Mask recovered from a dead operative contains a steganographic payload that, when decoded, appears to be a live feed from inside a Vantablack Media executive's private residence.

physical_description.visual_profile: A translucent, paper-thin adhesive membrane with an iridescent black finish that seems to absorb light rather than reflect it. When applied to skin, it becomes nearly invisible at casual distance, appearing as a subtle sheen or faint prismatic distortion. The surface has a soft, matte quality broken only by gossamer-thin conductive traceries visible at oblique angles.
physical_description.dimensions: Facial overlay variant 22cm x 14cm; forearm variant 18cm x 8cm; thickness approximately 0.3mm
physical_description.weight_description: Sub-30 grams — lighter than a postage stamp, completely imperceptible when worn
physical_description.primary_material: Biocompatible elastomer substrate with embedded graphene conductive mesh and piezoelectric microlayers
physical_description.finish: Vantablack-coated surface with anti-reflective nanotexture; edges slightly raised and beveled for seamless adhesion
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep absorption black with hints of oil-slick iridescence at acute viewing angles; subtle silver tracery of conductive pathways visible under close inspection
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimal — microscopic application nodes at corners; integrated bioelectric harvest sites calibrated to skin conductivity; no visible indicators, buttons, or screens
distinctive_features: Liquid-like surface that catches light as though it's drinking photons
Barely-perceptible circular harvest nodes (3mm diameter) positioned at pulse points
Hairline conductive pathways forming organic circuit patterns reminiscent of neural tissue
Sealed edge trim with subtle holo-reactive security gradient visible only under specific wavelengths
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Microscopic Vantablack Media logo embossed at one corner; invisible unless backlit; regulatory cipher stamps in UV-reactive ink along lower edge
physical_description.condition_typical: When worn on face: appears as cosmetic skin treatment or subtle AR display artifact; slight thermal blooming around edges if actively transmitting; after 48+ hours shows minor creasing at articulation points (jaw, neck, wrist)
